says: stepcommit.sh --commit-only, run on a checked-out branch, left HEAD detached with the new commit on it and the branch ref still at its base, so git push -u origin <branch> pushed the base.
proof: Slice E98 tests step: git status -sb printed 'HEAD (no branch)' after the commit; git ls-remote showed the branch at its base while HEAD was one commit ahead; fixed by checking the branch out and fast-forwarding it to the commit.
cost: A step reports a pushed head that origin does not hold, until someone compares git ls-remote with HEAD.
